disposition_reason: ICP-MS/MS survey of 180 flavoured dairy products from Giza, Egypt (15 per product-flavour). Chocolate items are chocolate pasteurized milk, chocolate UHT milk, chocolate milk powder and chocolate ice cream, all flavoured dairy composites; no cocoa powder, drinking-chocolate powder or chocolate itself was analysed. Chocolate milk powder had the highest Al (4.785 ± 1.590 mg/kg) and Cr (1.279 mg/kg), which the authors attribute partly to cocoa powder, but these are dairy-matrix values.
